problem: E11..E29 each validated 1 piece of the Currency Layer in isolation (a Guard, the Contract, the classifier, or 1 real target at a time) -- whether the FULL pipeline holds together across BOTH real targets in ONE integrated pass had not been checked.

decision.decision_summary: Ran the full, unmodified Currency pipeline (Guard -> Contract -> classifier -> operational rule) against both real subjects simultaneously: Experience Index=EXPECTED_SELF_CAPTURE_STALE (MAINTAIN_NO_REFRESH), PB Pointer=CURRENT (REUSE_AS_IS). Full agreement confirmed at every link. 0 modification either way.

result.note: Confirms integrated operational readiness of the Currency Layer; does not refresh the Index, does not modify the pointer chain, does not change this Goal's own real status.

cause.root_cause_summary: Each Currency sub-mechanism (E11, E25, E26, E28) had only ever been exercised individually or with 1 target at a time -- a combined, both-targets-at-once real pass had not yet been run.

lesson: Integrated readiness is not implied by each individual piece having already been verified separately -- running the whole real chain together, once, is what actually confirms the pieces compose correctly; here they did, with 0 new logic required.
